items.title: For Timure’s flood survivors, Dashain brings memories of the lives they lost
items.blurb: Displaced by the Bhotekoshi flood, 111 families are spending the festival in a Kathmandu monastery, grieving loved ones and wondering when they can return home.

items.title: In Gorkha’s flood-hit villages, even cooking a meal is a struggle
items.blurb: The Budhigandaki flood destroyed homes and disrupted road links, leaving families dependent on limited helicopter deliveries for food and other essentials.

items.title: Baglung flood survivors face Dashain without homes as rebuilding stalls
items.blurb: Families in Baglung are living in a cooperative building, relatives’ homes and a buffalo shed after floods swept away their houses and farmland. Many struggle to secure land and meet government requirements for…

items.title: Tourist arrivals in Mustang plunge 41.5 percent
items.blurb: Floods, heavy rain and prolonged closure of the Beni-Jomsom road disrupt access to the Himalayan district during the autumn tourism season.

items.title: Nepal set Oman 281-run target after Paudel-Airee rescue act
items.blurb: Their record 139-run fourth-wicket stand helped Nepal recover from an early collapse in a must-win Cricket World Cup League 2 match.
